prayerExcerpt.en-US: Thus we shall both live and die to God, perfectly resigned to His holy will in all His appointments.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Assim viveremos e morreremos para Deus, perfeitamente resignados à Sua santa vontade em todas as Suas disposições.

meta.face: A Milanese of about fifty with a warm, light-olive complexion and a WEDGE-SHAPED face — a BROAD, SQUARE, flat forehead and wide temples, a HEAVY, STRAIGHT brow ridge, the cheeks falling in STRAIGHT lines to a NARROW, firm chin; a long, straight nose with a strong, SQUARED tip; deep-set, level, dark-grey eyes under thick, straight dark brows; a firm, narrow mouth; short, dense, dark-brown hair cropped close, greying at the temples; a SHORT, trimmed dark beard following the narrow jaw to a blunt point; the gaze steady and resolute, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; Wikipedia's lead image is Carpaccio's altarpiece of him as a knight on a white horse. The book tells a citizen of Milan who, at Ravenna, encouraged the wavering Ursicinus to die for the faith, buried him, and was racked and buried alive at the place called the Palm-tree; its engraving shows him with a spade beside Ursicinus's body. Wikipedia calls the story a legend and holds only the martyrdom at Ravenna, of which he is the principal patron. The wedge-shaped face is our choice; the background keeps to Roman Ravenna, before the basilica built over his shrine.
